**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Build the readback from the final authenticated inputs**

If any declared input changes between the preview build and the second `_make_config()` call—for example during concurrent artifact regeneration—the final config authenticates and builds from the new bytes, while the supplemental readback still embeds the preview delta/projection receipts and counts. Because the readback is then treated as a static supplemental document and only its own bytes are manifest-bound, materialization can succeed with `artifact_bytes` that do not match the actual final outputs; derive or verify the readback against the same final authenticated build.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate the delayed-review evidence identities**

When a reviewed-source artifact is regenerated and admitted with a refreshed receipt, this check accepts corrupted audit evidence as long as the two counts remain 13: changing `affected_question_ids`, an evidence ref's `question_id`, or its `sha256` still passes `validate_reviewed_source()` and therefore the production callback. This defeats the newly added fail-closed validation for the claimed original-pixel repair; verify that the affected IDs equal `DELAYED_REVIEW_QUESTION_IDS` and that every audit ref matches the corresponding authenticated QP/MS evidence identity.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require complete step chains for every branch**

When a reviewed-source artifact is regenerated with a refreshed receipt, this loop validates only the steps that happen to be present; deleting one step—or every step in `profit_per_day_then_total`—still passes `validate_reviewed_source()` and the generic overlay validator. The resulting authenticated delta can therefore retain the newly added alternative ProcedureInstances while silently omitting their procedure guidance, so validate the expected contiguous step set for each branch-scoped instance rather than only checking surviving steps.

body: Fixed in df042ee23. `make_config()` now creates one preview config, builds the preview/readback from it, and attaches the supplemental output with `dataclasses.replace`; it no longer calls `_make_config()` a second time or refreshes input receipts. The new race test mutates a declared input immediately after preview/readback construction and proves the final config fails raw-byte authentication instead of materializing mismatched readback receipts.
